title: Health, damage and recovery
summary: R.E.P.O. tracks how alive your crew and the monsters are: the game keeps health for players and for monsters, shows it in its own interface, and has a pack you can carry to recover.
body: Players have health of their own, so what hurts you is a value rather than a binary state.
Monsters have health too, which is why fighting one is a contest of values rather than an all-or-nothing hit.
Recovery is equipment: a health pack exists as a carried item, so patching someone up depends on what the crew brought with them.
What this entry does not tell you: how much health anyone has, how much damage anything does, or how much a pack restores. We have not verified those numbers, so we do not print them.

facts.claim: Monsters have tracked health as well.
Health is shown in its own interface.
Recovery uses a carried health pack.
